name: Sakura Inaho
source:
An old friend of the protagonist.

She always makes an effort to help him out with any problems, but more often than not, she usually ends up causing new ones.

Likes: Merch with dogs on it, unusual kinds of sweets
Dislikes: Scary stories
Hobbies: Collecting unusual trinkets (that she considers cute)
